stories.title: Show HN: RealtimeVAD – trading false positives for 110ms earlier end-of-speech
summary: I recently watched the latency reports for my local voice assistant, which show a waveform plus silero probability for voice activity.
I noticed silero lags visibly on the speech off signal.There had to be a method to get this signal closer to what I felt is optimal.
If it's wrong and the user continues speaking I can abort the pipeline fast.I benchmarked my solution over ~3200 turns from my assistant logs and it came out ~110 ms faster initially.
